title: Continuation and missing work
summary: The HTTPS host-boundary design gap is implemented in the v0.4.8/dev6 candidate pair; the remaining gate is exact-r13196 and live TLS qualification before canonical promotion.
invariants: Accepted WebDAV baseline remains dev5 until the dev6 runtime gate passes.
Ordinary PUT may be claimed before buffering and delivered to WebDavStreamingUploadSession in bounded chunks.
A disconnect or abort before commit must leave no DAV namespace/catalogue publication.
Full ordinary GET may stream a StorageByteSource through HTTPS without whole-object materialisation.
Reusable StorageByteSource registrations must be factory-backed so concurrent GETs do not share mutable read position.
Sequential-media PUT remains representation-aware and is not silently routed through the ordinary byte-object stream.
Further work includes full multi-resource tagged If semantics, optional RFC 6578 selection detail, live OS/client interoperability and live Queue Fabric broker qualification.

provenance.claim: Streaming integration candidate; static PASS, runtime qualification pending.
